comment: Published releases of the eye-embedding model, oldest first; the last entry is current.
`served: true` means this version's files are committed under packages/core/models/ and
are therefore deployed to saccade.jspsych.org. GitHub Pages only serves the current
build, so a version drops off the site the moment its bytes leave the repo -- keep
`served` honest, and give superseded versions a durable link (npm/jsDelivr or a DOI)
Produced by web/export in jspsych/eye-tracking; see that repo's ARCHITECTURE.md.
